These frames are designed to turn your CZ P-07 or P-09 parts kits back into functional firearms. YAY!
I may have gotten some of the geometry wrong, aesthetically. However, these should be functional frames.

These frames are compatible with all generations of parts kits. That includes the older "Duty" kits. When shopping for a magazine, keep in mind what frame you're going to use. The P-07 frames will accept all magazines. The P-09 and P-07x will only accept the P-09 sized magazines. There are grip sleeves to convert the longer P-09 magazines to look good with the P-07 length frames. The P-07X has the P-09 grip length but is for a P-07 length "compact" frame.
